description: Use this when the signed-in clipper asks to remove, disconnect or delete one of their TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or X accounts on ClippingAlpha, for example "disconnect my TikTok @rin.clipz, I mistyped it". Removes that one account, waiting for its code or connected, the same as Remove on the clipper's Profile, and For you then ranks for the accounts left. Removed within 7 days of being connected, the AlphaPoints it earned go back. A mistyped handle still waiting for its code can also be fixed by connect_account with the right one, which replaces it. Only the clipper's own accounts. Needs the clipper's ClippingAlpha sign-in. Nothing changes on the social account.

handle.description: The account's handle, as @name, name or its profile link.

platform.description: The social app: tiktok, instagram, youtube or x.

name: remove_account
title: Remove a social account
